info.description: Business-rule boundary for PawGuard 360. Every endpoint documents its permission requirement. Organisation-scoped endpoints require the `X-PawGuard-Org` header; membership is verified server-side on every request.
info.title: PawGuard 360 API

get.description: Permission: ``animal.read``. Newest first.

post.description: Permission: ``animal.write`` or ``animal.merge``. Nothing changes until a different person approves.

Permission: ``animal.read``. Read-only: shows both profiles, how many linked records would move and any
conflicting details.

get.description: Permission: ``animal.read``.

post.description: Permission: ``animal.merge`` + live session; must not be the proposer. Records every moved link.
Permission: ``animal.merge``.
Permission: ``animal.merge`` + live session. Moves back exactly the links recorded at execution.

get.description:
Permission: ``animal.read``. Results are limited to the selected organisation. Caregiver contacts and exact
locations are never part of registry results.

post.description:
Permission: ``animal.write`` (plus ``observation.write`` when a first observation is included). New
profiles are always ``provisional``. Supports ``Idempotency-Key`` and ``client_operation_id``.

get.description: Permission: ``animal.read``. Merged aliases are returned with ``merged_into_reference``.

patch.description: Permission: ``animal.write``. Requires the current ``row_version``; a stale version returns 409.

get.description:
Permission: ``animal.read``. Coordinates are exact only with ``animal.location.exact``; otherwise they are
snapped to a ~500 m grid and marked approximate.

post.description:
Permission: ``animal.write`` to flag a dispute; ``animal.merge`` to review, activate, resolve or archive.
Disputes, archiving and resolving a dispute require a reason.
post.summary: Review, dispute or archive a profile

get.description: Permission: any member. Areas currently in effect for the organisation.
Permission: ``audit.read``. Change summaries are redacted (field names and state changes only).
Permission: ``campaign.manage`` or ``task.manage``.

post.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage``.

get.description:
Permission: ``campaign.manage`` or ``task.manage``. Each area shows the manual estimate if set, otherwise
a suggestion with its source (latest street count, else registry records).
Permission: ``campaign.manage`` or ``task.manage``. Newest first.

post.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage``. Snapshots the inputs and queues the solver; poll until ``ready``.

get.description:
Permission: ``animal.read``. This clinic's registered pets only: due this week, overdue, awaiting
verification. Counts describe pets registered in this app, not population coverage.
Permission: clinic staff (``animal.read`` or ``vaccination.review``).
get.summary: Today's date for reminders (with any demo offset)

put.description:
Permission: clinic staff, in a demo organisation, with demo mode on. Changes only what "today" means for
status and reminders in this organisation; stored dates are not changed. Audited.
put.summary: Move the demo date (demo organisations only)

get.description: Permission: clinic staff. Shows delivery states and provider status (e.g. "token expired"), never addresses.

post.description: Permission: clinic staff in a demo organisation with demo mode on. Normally runs every 10 minutes.

Permission: ``vaccination.review`` with an approved ``veterinary_review`` authority and a live session.
Stored as verified (the vet's own record) with the vet's next due date, or the demo template if none.
post.summary: Record a vaccination given at the clinic (vet)

get.description:
Permission: public, but only exists when ``PAWGUARD_DEMO_MODE=true`` outside production. Lists the fictional
seed accounts (no passwords) for the development sign-in shortcuts.

Permission: ``report.aggregate``. Only this organisation's records; never caregiver contacts, coordinates or
free-text notes. The first line declares the data mode (demo/live). Every export is audited.
Permission: ``identity.search``. Counts of decisions relative to the suggestions (correction feedback).

post.description:
Permission: ``identity.search``. Queues a search of this organisation's gallery for an approved photo
(optionally a chosen subject box). Returns ``pending``, or ``unavailable`` immediately.

get.description: Permission: ``identity.search``. Candidates carry a rank and supporting photos — never a percentage.

post.description:
Permission: ``identity.decide``. Same animal (choose it), new animal, or not sure. Recording a decision does
not link anything by itself; the sighting or registration is created as a separate, explicit step.

get.description:
Permission: ``identity.search``. ``unavailable`` with a reason when no validated model exists; demo
organisations may see ``research_preview`` (never offered for real records).
Permission: ``data.import``.

post.description:
Permission: ``data.import``. Stores the raw file immutably (≤ 2 MB, UTF-8 CSV) and returns a validation
report. Nothing is created until the import is applied.
post.summary: Upload a CSV and run a dry run

get.description: Permission: ``data.import``. The report contains partner data and is restricted accordingly.

post.description:
Permission: ``data.import`` + ``animal.write`` (animals) or ``vaccination.submit`` (vaccinations). One
transaction; rejected and previously imported rows are never applied; vaccination rows arrive as submitted.
Permission: ``data.import`` + ``animal.merge``. Archives the created records if none has been used since.

get.description:
Permission: ``animal.read``. Sighting points are exact only with ``animal.location.exact`` and otherwise
snapped to a ~500 m grid. At most 2,000 sightings (most recent) are returned; ``truncated`` says if more exist.
Permission: any signed-in user. Capabilities come from the database, never from the token.

patch.description: Permission: any signed-in user, own profile only. Requires the current ``row_version``.
patch.summary: Update own display name or language

get.description:
Permission: an active member. Lets clients (e.g. the offline field kit) bind queued work to the organisation
and account the server will apply it to.
get.summary: The organisation requests are made for

post.description:
Permission: ``media.upload``. Returns a signed URL for exactly one quarantined object key. Uploading does not
make a file trusted: it is validated from its bytes before it can be shown or used as evidence.

delete.description: Permission: uploader only. Files already attached to a record are kept as evidence.

get.description: Permission: ``animal.read``. Poll this for validation progress.

Permission: ``animal.read``. Advisory only: boxes say where an animal *may* be in the photo so the person can
choose the subject; they do not identify the animal. ``unavailable``/``failed`` never block manual entry.

post.description:
Permission: ``media.upload``, uploader only. Checks the stored object's size and declared type, then queues
validation. Idempotent.

get.description:
Permission: ``animal.read``. Only approved files; links expire after 120 seconds and access is audited.
``original`` refers to the validated, metadata-stripped copy (PDF evidence is stored as uploaded).
get.summary: Short-lived link to a validated file

get.description: Permission: ``task.manage`` or ``member.manage`` (names and roles only — no contact details).

post.description:
Permission: ``member.manage`` + live session. Takes effect on the member's next request (membership is read
on every request); queued offline work is re-checked when it syncs.

get.description: Permission: any signed-in user (empty unless they hold ``pet.own`` somewhere).
Permission: any signed-in user, own settings only.

put.description: Permission: any signed-in user, own settings only. Every channel is opt-in.
put.summary: Turn email, push or WhatsApp reminders on or off

post.description: Permission: any member. At most 5 test messages an hour. Sent by the worker within about 15 seconds.

get.description: Permission: ``pet.own`` in at least one clinic. Only pets linked to the caller as owner.

post.description: Permission: ``pet.own`` in the chosen clinic. The pet is linked to the caller as owner.
post.summary: Register my pet with a clinic

get.description: Permission: the caller owns this pet; otherwise 404.
get.summary: My pet: status, timeline and reminders

delete.description: Permission: the caller owns this pet. The QR code stops working until a new card is created.

get.description: Permission: the caller owns this pet. Creates the card's random token on first use.

parameters.description: Web origin for the QR link, e.g. https://example.org
parameters.name: base_url

schema.description: Web origin for the QR link, e.g. https://example.org
schema.title: Base Url

get.description: Permission: the caller owns this pet. Verified vaccinations only, with the QR code and disclaimer.

parameters.description: Web origin for the QR link, e.g. https://example.org
parameters.name: base_url

schema.description: Web origin for the QR link, e.g. https://example.org
schema.title: Base Url

post.description: Permission: the caller owns this pet. Revokes the current token and issues a new one.

parameters.description: Web origin for the QR link, e.g. https://example.org
parameters.name: base_url

schema.description: Web origin for the QR link, e.g. https://example.org
schema.title: Base Url

post.summary: New QR code (old one stops working)

post.description:
Permission: the caller owns this pet. Creates an unverified owner-entered record that goes to the clinic's
vet workbench. It never counts as verified until a vet verifies it.
post.summary: Add a past vaccination with a certificate (unverified until a vet reviews it)

get.description: Permission: the caller owns this pet.

post.description: Permission: any signed-in user, own subscriptions only. Only known browser push services are accepted.
post.summary: Turn on notifications in this browser

post.description: Permission: any signed-in user, own subscriptions only.
post.summary: Turn off notifications in this browser

get.description: Permission: owner. In-app reminders only; ``preview`` shows what an email/SMS would say (nothing is sent).
Permission: the reminder's owner. An all-day event on the due date (date only, no time zone shift).
get.summary: Calendar file for the due date

post.description:
Permission: the reminder's owner. Records an unverified owner entry (with certificate) for the vet to review
and stops the reminders for that due date. If the vet rejects it, the reminders come back.
post.summary: Mark a reminder done with a certificate

post.description: Permission: the reminder's owner.
post.summary: Snooze a reminder for 1 or 3 days

post.description:
Permission: ``observation.write``. ``animal_id`` may be omitted while identity is unresolved. Notes must
be non-diagnostic. Supports ``Idempotency-Key`` and ``client_operation_id``.

get.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage`` or ``task.manage``.

post.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage``. Approval does not dispatch anything.
Permission: ``campaign.manage`` + ``task.manage``. Creates one assigned field task per planned stop.
post.summary: Publish an approved plan as tasks

post.description:
Permission: ``professional.approve`` + live session. The approver cannot approve themselves (enforced in the
database too). PawGuard does not check external professional registers: the approver records what they
verified in ``evidence_reference``.
Permission: ``professional.approve`` + live session.

get.description: Permission: ``animal.read``. Counts are registry measures, not coverage (see ``note``).

Permission: public. Unknown and revoked tokens both return 404. Shows the pet's name, species, photo, clinic
name and verified vaccinations only — nothing about the owner or any location.
Permission: public (the public half of the VAPID key pair). Null when push is not set up.

post.description:
Permission: ``survey.write``. Counts are observations, not a census; they become the default estimate
for planning that area.

Each operation is replayed with the sender's *current* permissions and reported as accepted, conflict or
rejected; already-received operations return their stored outcome (``duplicate``). Operations must belong to
the signed-in account and the selected organisation.
Only for your own operations that were not applied.
post.summary: Record how a conflict was handled

get.description: Permission: ``system.view`` in the selected organisation.
Permission: ``task.work`` (own tasks) or ``task.manage`` (all tasks in the organisation).

post.description: Permission: ``task.manage``. Assignees must be active members with ``task.work``.

get.description: Permission: ``task.work`` or ``task.manage``.

post.description:
Permission: the assignee (``task.work``) may start, complete or block their task; ``task.manage`` may do
anything including assign, cancel and reopen. Blocking and cancelling need a reason. Requires ``row_version``.
post.summary: Start, complete, block, assign or cancel

get.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage`` or ``task.manage``.

post.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage``.

get.description: Permission: ``animal.read``.

post.description:
Permission: ``vaccination.submit``. The record is created as ``submitted`` (or ``draft``) — never
``verified``. A state cannot be supplied. Supports ``Idempotency-Key`` and ``client_operation_id`` so a
retried or replayed submission never creates a second administration.

get.description: Permission: ``animal.read``. Includes evidence (short-lived links for approved files) and review history.

post.description:
Permission: ``vaccination.submit`` (original submitter) or ``task.manage``. Only for records marked
``needs_correction`` or drafts. Creates a new record that supersedes the old one; nothing is deleted.

Permission: ``vaccination.review`` + approved ``veterinary_review`` authority + a live session. The reviewer
cannot be the submitter. Requires the event's ``row_version``; concurrent reviews return 409. Rejection and
correction requests need a reason; a correction request assigns a follow-up task to the submitter.

get.description:
Permission: ``vaccination.review`` with an approved ``veterinary_review`` professional authority. Oldest
first; the reviewer's own submissions are excluded.
Permission: any member.

post.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage``.

get.description: Permission: any member. ``review_state`` shows whether a qualified person has reviewed the entry.

post.description: Permission: ``campaign.manage``. New products are ``unreviewed``.
